# Managed Project AI Instructions

Adopt `UniversalStandards/UniversalStandards` as the upstream reusable AI engineering standard and follow the local `AGENTS.md` for project-specific constraints.

Before declaring work blocked, distinguish the project from the current connector/tool/agent limitation and search already-authorized alternatives, including GitHub-native issue-to-agent delegation where appropriate.

Do not weaken security, approval, review, identity, audit, release, or production-authority controls to unblock work. Do not fabricate credentials or permissions.

Promote reusable verified lessons into durable instructions, runbooks, templates/prompts/skills, ADRs, tests, evaluations, CI, or policy-as-code at the correct scope. Independently verify delegated work before considering it complete.
